name: nimbus
description: NIMBUS — Newell Integrated Batch & Unified Scheduling. No build step; static frontend. This package.json exists only for the ESLint static-analysis gate.

scripts.lint: eslint web/app.js web/nimbus-intelligence.js web/nimbus-worker.js web/nimbus-compute-core.js web/locales "web/**/*.mjs" scripts tests/modules
scripts.lint:errors: eslint web/app.js web/nimbus-intelligence.js web/nimbus-worker.js web/nimbus-compute-core.js web/locales --quiet
scripts.lint:ci: eslint web/app.js web/nimbus-intelligence.js web/nimbus-worker.js web/nimbus-compute-core.js "web/**/*.mjs" scripts tests/modules --quiet
scripts.test: npm run test:legacy && npm run test:modules
